# OpenComputer Serverless Agents

> Build, test, and deploy serverless agents as code with OpenComputer.

## Getting started

- [Serverless Agents](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/overview.md): Define reactive agents in TypeScript and run them in the OpenComputer cloud.
- [How it works](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/mental-model.md): A mental model for agent functions, the managed harness, durable sessions, capabilities, and triggers.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/quickstart.md): Create an agent project and sync it to Development (Cloud).
- [Projects and agents](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/projects.md): Organize multiple cloud agents in one project.

## Concepts

- [Reactive agents](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/reactive-agents.md): Render instructions and capabilities from the current input.
- [Sessions and turns](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/sessions.md): Understand durable conversations and multi-turn agent work.
- [Memory](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/memory.md): Read and save notes across sessions.
- [Database](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/database.md): A durable SQL database shared by every session in a project environment.
- [Schedules](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/schedules.md): Run an agent from a code-defined cron schedule.
- [Agent webhooks](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/webhooks.md): Start an agent session from an external service.
- [Agent capabilities](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/capabilities.md): Choose tools, MCP servers, skills, subagents, memory and outbound connections.
- [Secrets and runtime variables](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/secrets.md): Configure managed outbound credentials and agent runtime environment variables.
- [Connected services](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/services.md): Call Google services, GitHub, and Linear with a credential the platform holds and refreshes.
- [GitHub App connections](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/github.md): Give an agent direct Git and GitHub API access with the managed OpenComputer App.
- [Slack connections](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/slack.md): Connect a deployed agent to Slack from the dashboard so people can talk to it in threads.
- [Linear connections](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/linear.md): Make a deployed agent a teammate people delegate issues to and mention in Linear.
- [Bring your own model account (BYOK)](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/byok.md): Use a Codex account for model inference in Serverless Agents.
- [Deployments and environments](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/deployments.md): Understand development, production, immutable deployments, and aliases.

## Build an application

- [React integration](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/react.md): Create sessions on your server; attach, submit work and reopen them with useAgent.
- [Serverless Agents client](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/reference/typescript-sdk/agents.md): Create sessions, submit work and read results from your application's server.
- [Management API](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/api.md): Create sessions, send turns, read the event log and manage projects over HTTP.
- [Session events](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/events.md): The durable event log every session keeps and every consumer reads.

## Agent API

- [Agent hooks](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/hooks.md): Compose agent capabilities with reactive hooks.
- [Inputs](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/inputs.md): Read text, structured payloads, and input sources with useInput.
- [Models](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/models.md): Select a model with useModel.
- [Tools](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/tools.md): Define TypeScript tools and expose them with useTool.
- [MCP servers](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/mcp.md): Attach managed HTTPS MCP servers with useMcpServer.
- [Skills](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/skills.md): Package reusable instructions and supporting resources with an agent.
- [Subagents](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/subagents.md): Let an agent delegate focused work with useSubagent.
- [Session data](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/session-data.md): Read durable per-session values with useSessionData.
- [Document memory](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/document-memory.md): Configuration, session bindings, tools and owner APIs.
- [Memory providers](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/memory-providers.md): Provider responsibilities, document memory and the proposed HTTP contract.

## Test and operate

- [Playground and debugging](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/playground.md): Test deployments and inspect what the agent received for each turn.
- [Logs](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/logs.md): Inspect agent output and outbound-request activity from the OpenComputer CLI.

## Examples

- [GTM engineer](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/examples/gtm-engineer.md): A scheduled go-to-market agent that researches opportunities with Exa and keeps every action in dry-run mode.
- [Feature flag hygiene](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/examples/feature-flag-hygiene.md): Inspect Unleash flags, find safe cleanup candidates, and open focused pull requests.
- [A coding agent in Slack](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/examples/slack-coder.md): Deploy a coding teammate that takes work from Slack and opens draft pull requests.
- [Pull Request Reviewer](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/examples/pr-review.md): Fetch a PR through a managed GitHub connection, review it, and post inline comments on request.
- [Add high-value regression tests](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/examples/test-coverage.md): Review recent merges and open focused, test-only pull requests for material coverage gaps.
